title: Lockheed Skunk Works response to Grusch's testimony
summary: Jesse Michels tells of Lockheed Skunk Works response to Grusch's testimony, about 2023 at Lockheed Martin Skunk Works, and frames it as the host. As told, not a fact.

tellings.quote:
notably their response to gush's
testimony was pretty telling they said
questions about uaps are best answered
by the federal government

plain: A podcast host, Jesse Michels, talks about how Lockheed Martin, a big defense company, and its secret advanced projects division, known as Skunk Works, answered 2023 testimony to Congress by David Grusch, a former intelligence officer who said the government holds non-human craft. Michels says the company replied only that questions about unexplained aerial phenomena are best answered by the federal government. He finds that answer telling, as if the company were not denying it.
